The '''BD series''' was a series of [[Class three droid/Legends|class three]] [[Nanny droid/Legends|Nanny droids]] in use during the [[Old Republic era]]. Jedi Knight [[Kerra Holt]] encountered several of these in the stronghold of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] twins [[Dromika]] and [[Quillan (Sith)|Quillan]] on the planet [[Byllura]]. They were charged with taking care of the twins, as neither of them was capable of taking care of themselves.

When the Jedi tried to reach the twins, the nanny droids tried to intervene. While they were unarmed, they used their bulky mass to hurl themselves at Holt, who disposed of them with both her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and her [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]] with considerable ease.
